## Discovery & Translational Science

* **[PRISM2 multimodal pathology foundation model matches clinical diagnostic accuracy](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04521-4)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * Trained on 2.3 million whole-slide images and 14 million clinical question-answer pairs, PRISM2 achieved clinical-grade cancer detection across multiple tissue types without task-specific fine-tuning.
  * Integrates clinical dialogue supervision to enable interactive, explainable computational pathology workflows.

* **[Visual foundation model trained on 5.2M routine clinical scans advances neuroimaging AI](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04567-4)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * A 3D vision foundation model trained on 5.24 million routine CT and MRI image series established a unified latent representation of neuroanatomy and brain pathology.
  * Outperformed public-data-trained models in automated diagnostic accuracy, triage, and preliminary radiology report generation.

* **[Gene mutant allele dosage predicts metastatic tropism across 60,000 tumor samples](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42538373/)** — *PubMed*
  * Pan-cancer genomic analysis revealed that somatic mutant gene dosage (copy-number altered mutant allele burden) dictates organ-specific metastatic tropism and overall survival across major solid tumors.

* **[Non-invasive urinary bile-acid metabolite identified as biomarker for never-smoker lung cancer](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.27.26359037)** — *medRxiv*
  * Quantification of 27-nor-5β-cholestane-3,7,12,24R,25S-pentol glucuronide (CPG) across discovery (n=846) and validation (n=505) cohorts demonstrated significant elevation in never-smoker NSCLC cases versus controls.
  * CPG levels correlated with aryl-hydrocarbon-receptor (AhR) and CYP xenobiotic metabolic signaling in tumor tissue.

* **[Single-nucleus multiomic map reveals tissue-specific regulatory loci in osteoarthritis](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.27.26358831)** — *medRxiv*
  * Combined cis-eQTL mapping and single-nucleus profiling of human synovium and infrapatellar fat pad identified 970 and 487 tissue-specific eGenes, respectively.
  * Fine-mapping linked disease risk to rare promoter variants reducing *VEGFA* expression, an adipocyte-specific enhancer of *ABCA9*, and an inflammatory RNA-binding protein variant (*RBM6*).

* **[Heading soccer balls triggers immediate spikes in p-Tau217 and S100B](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41591-026-00039-x)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * Amateur soccer players engaging in subconcussive ball heading during a single match exhibited immediate, dose-dependent blood elevations in neural damage markers p-Tau217 and S100B.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Biotech]** **[Inhaled caveolin-1 peptide LTI-03 completes Phase 1 dose escalation in IPF](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42538332/)** — *PubMed*
  * Evaluated the safety, tolerability, and pharmacokinetics of inhaled LTI-03, a Caveolin-1 scaffolding domain peptide inhibitor, in a randomized dose-escalation trial in patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.

* **[Biotech]** **[FLO23011 substrate improves hypoglycemia recovery in Type 1 diabetes](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.29.26359225)** — *medRxiv*
  * In a randomized crossover study of 12 adults with T1D, FLO23011 (a glucose/beta-hydroxybutyrate multi-energy substrate) demonstrated superior patient-reported recovery metrics across 13 of 14 domains compared to standard glucose gel.

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Astellas and Sutro advance dual-payload ADC ASP388B into Phase 1](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2083192160489246925)** — *Jacob Plieth / X*
  * ASP388B has entered clinical development as the second dual-payload antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) originating from the collaboration between Astellas ($ALPMF) and Sutro Biopharma ($STRO).
  * The construct targets B7-H3 and incorporates a dual-payload mechanism combining a topoisomerase I inhibitor (topo1i) with a STING agonist.
  * It follows the partners' first clinical dual-payload ADC, ASP2998 (anti-TROP2), which entered Phase 1 trial evaluation in January.

* **[Biotech]** **[Umoja Biopharma initiates Phase 1 trial for in vivo CAR-T candidate UB-VV500](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2083158204075147281)** — *Jacob Plieth / X*
  * Umoja Biopharma has advanced its next-generation in vivo CAR-T candidate, UB-VV500, into Phase 1 clinical testing.
  * The company simultaneously disclosed the therapeutic mechanism of action driving the candidate.

* **[Biotech]** **[Moleculin Biotech reports interim Phase 1/2 MIRACLE data in R/R AML](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2083164134414090330)** — *BioStocks / X*
  * Moleculin Biotech ($MBRX) released interim clinical results from its MIRACLE trial in relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (R/R AML).
  * The study demonstrated a 37% blinded composite complete remission rate (CRc) in patients who had failed prior treatment with venetoclax.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Novo Nordisk’s ziltivekimab fails primary endpoint in Phase 3 ZEUS trial](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/novo-nordik-ziltivekimab-zeus-study-results-corvidia/826695/)** — *BioPharma Dive / STAT*
  * Ziltivekimab, an anti-IL-6 monoclonal antibody acquired via Corvidia Therapeutics for $725 million upfront, failed to reduce major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) in patients with cardiovascular disease and chronic kidney disease.
  * Novo Nordisk will record a non-cash impairment charge in Q3 2026; two parallel Phase 3 trials in heart failure and acute myocardial infarction remain ongoing with results expected next year.

* **[FLOWS pivotal trial validates self-forming magnetic gastrointestinal anastomosis](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42538399/)** — *PubMed*
  * North American pivotal trial met primary endpoints for functional lumen opening using a self-forming magnetic compression device to establish GI tract surgical anastomosis.

* **[Biotech]** **[Moderna norovirus vaccine candidate misses early success threshold in Phase 3 interim analysis](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2083158944105541793)** — *BioStocks / X*
  * Moderna's ($MRNA) investigational norovirus vaccine candidate, mRNA-1403, did not meet statistical criteria for early efficacy success at a planned Phase 3 interim analysis.
  * The company is expanding enrollment to add an additional trial cohort to continue clinical evaluation.

## Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Big Pharma]** **[FDA approves Novartis’s Pluvicto for front-line metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/resources-information-approved-drugs/fda-approves-lutetium-lu-177-vipivotide-tetraxetan-androgen-receptor-pathway-inhibitor-therapy)** — *FDA*
  * Approved lutetium Lu 177 vipivotide tetraxetan (Pluvicto) in combination with androgen receptor pathway inhibitor (ARPI) therapy for adults with PSMA-positive metastatic androgen pathway modulation-naïve or -sensitive (mAPMN/S) prostate cancer.
  * Approval is supported by efficacy data from the Phase 3 PSMAddition trial; patient selection requires baseline PSMA PET imaging (such as Locametz).

* **[Biotech]** **[FDA Advisory Committee endorses Replimune’s RP1 for advanced melanoma](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/07/31/novo-setback-fda-panel-endorses-replimune-melanoma-drug/)** — *STAT*
  * An FDA advisory panel voted in favor of recommending Replimune’s oncolytic immunotherapy RP1 (vusolimogene oderparevec) for advanced melanoma, following two previous Complete Response Letters from the agency.

* **[FDA updates guidance for complex generic drug approvals under Drug Competition Action Plan](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/guidance-compliance-regulatory-information/fda-drug-competition-action-plan)** — *FDA*
  * Under its Drug Competition Action Plan (DCAP) aligned with GDUFA III commitments, the FDA issued updated regulatory guidance documents intended to reduce review cycles and lower barriers for complex generic drug applications.
  * Specific updates include a final guidance on assessing adhesion for transdermal/topical ANDAs, a revised draft guidance evaluating irritation and sensitization potential, and updated in vivo bioequivalence guidance for topical dermatologic corticosteroids.

## Business & Strategy

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Sanofi seeks to rebuild Regeneron alliance following pipeline cuts](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/sanofi-bristol-myers-apnimed-relation-therapeutics/826559/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * Sanofi CEO Belén Garijo announced plans to restore trust and potentially expand the company's development alliance with Regeneron ahead of impending patent expirations for Dupixent.
  * The strategy follows Sanofi's recent decision to axe multiple clinical programs, including late-stage immunology assets amlitelimab (OX40L inhibitor) and itepekimab (IL-33 inhibitor).

* **[Biotech]** **[Apnimed joins wave of upsized biotech IPOs](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/sanofi-bristol-myers-apnimed-relation-therapeutics/826559/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * Sleep apnea drug developer Apnimed completed an upsized initial public offering to fund ongoing clinical development.

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Bristol Myers Squibb discontinues programs while preparing unexpected submission](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2083181522094346707)** — *Jacob Plieth / X*
  * Bristol Myers Squibb ($BMY) is discontinuing multiple undisclosed clinical development programs.
  * The pipeline reprioritization occurs alongside preparations for an unannounced regulatory filing.

## Public Health & Policy

* **[Trump administration revises 340B drug discount rebate pilot](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/07/31/trump-administration-revises-rebate-pilot-drug-discount-program-hospitals/)** — *STAT*
  * Revisions to the federal 340B drug discount program rebate pilot drew pushback from hospital trade groups over financial and operational impacts.

* **[Epidemiological review of 2026 Bundibugyo virus outbreak details preparedness gaps](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42537678/)** — *PubMed*
  * Analysis of the recent Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak highlights persistent deficiencies in regional surveillance, rapid diagnostic deployment, and emergency epidemic countermeasures.

**Worth watching:** Readouts from Novo Nordisk's two remaining Phase 3 ziltivekimab trials in heart failure and acute myocardial infarction next year will clarify whether IL-6-targeted anti-inflammatory therapy retains efficacy in narrower cardiovascular indications.
